criteria.observations: Shared and personal v1 profiles expose project bindings, aliases, workspace declarations and ordered members. ConfigError retains declaring file and field.
Known types, required identities, versions, profile separation, YAML duplicates, entry keys and aliases are checked. Raw source, exact body bytes and unknown nested metadata survive parsing.

Saved paths resolve from the encountered configuration location. Physical identities preserve symlink parent traversal; SamePath handles same-file spelling. Unavailable targets remain declarations, and unresolvable identities retain errors for selection.
All new tests use independent temporary filesystems. The passing suite covers malformed YAML, relative paths, both profiles, duplicate declarations and separate record locations.

findings: Existing same-file paths with alternate casing needed identity comparison. SamePath now covers them.
Traversal through a regular file before .. needed rejection. CanonicalPath now rejects it.
